title: Copy replay
description: The event log's Copy replay button: any seated player can put the game's replay JSON (seed, seats, decisions, events) on the clipboard. Synthetic mocked game, not a captured engine state.

shots.heading: Event log: Copy replay
shots.caption: The button sits at the top of the open event log for every seated player, not only the host. Spectators do not get it.

shots.heading: Copied
shots.caption: One click loads the replay from GET /api/games/{id}/replay and writes it to the clipboard; the status line (a polite live region) says it was copied and how big it is. If the clipboard is blocked the same text is saved as ti4-replay-<game>.json instead and the status says so.

shots.heading: Server refused
shots.caption: A refusal shows the server's reason in the status line; the button is usable again. The button is disabled only while the replay is loading.

notes: The replay contains every player's decisions and the game seed, so it is not a spectator-safe export: sharing it reveals hidden information.
